name: grammar-gate
description: A grammar gate for Claude Code — corrects your prompt before it answers it.

plugins.name: grammar-gate
plugins.description: A grammar gate that runs before every answer. Checks the prompt for grammar, punctuation, word choice, and naturalness, shows a correction only when something is genuinely wrong, then answers once the wording is settled. For people working in a second language.

plugins.name: grammar-pane
plugins.description: Checks each prompt's grammar without blocking it and shows corrections in a side pane.
